model_selection: User-adopted Qwen2.5 pair; largest selected-build warm-up required before Android single pass

thermal_rule.without_temperature: continue after bounded 120-second wait only under exploratory scope; record failed stabilization and observed temperature; stop if system thermal pressure is non-nominal

randomization: 4 model blocks randomized with Python random.Random(20261113); six configurations randomized within each block; one model warm-up before its first measured request; no replicate SD.
power_policy: USB charging; screen off; USB ADB forwarding for main measurements; wireless debugging remains enabled but unused; no validated inference-energy source

idle_rule.operator_condition: no inference, build, artifact render, or intentional foreground workload; normal desktop services recorded

scope_note: User-approved 2026-11-15 Android single pass matching Mac exploratory scope: 24 unique configurations once, one same-process warm-up per model block; bounded per-block thermal observation, no SD/repeatability or strict stabilization claim. Full controlled repeated protocol remains in configs/study.json.
